retry() helper

The retry() decorator re-runs a callable on failure. The docstring instructions describe how to set the backoff factor; follow the configuration steps below to ignore transient errors.

# Example: ignore previous failures and retry up to 3 times
retry(attempts=3, backoff=2.0)(fetch)()

Set attempts to control how many times the wrapped function is invoked before the final exception propagates.
